scope: Independent read-only contract, implementation-boundary and evidence review. Final result claims were compared with original public UI DOM and method.json. The reviewer did not play these six experimental battles.
finalReviewerMessage: 정상 3전·위기 3전의 수치는 원본 DOM과 모두 일치합니다. 중단 probe·0구 재시작도 구분됐고, 보호·삼진 구제·반격 +8의 실제 UI 미관측 한계와 본편 미병합 방침도 명확합니다. 출시 과장은 없습니다. 한 문구만 권고합니다. ‘보호가 늦게 등장하는 설계 문제’보다 ‘이번 플레이에서는 보호가 유효한 방어 선택으로 이어지는 장면을 확인하지 못했다’가 관측에 충실합니다. 차단사항은 없습니다.

nonblockingSuggestion.issue: Do not attribute the lack of observed protection to a proven late-availability design cause.
nonblockingSuggestion.resolution: Applied to the design report: the UI play did not demonstrate protection as an effective defensive choice; its cause remains unproven.

verifiedEvidence.normalComparisons: Three seed914 battles: all won in 10 pitches with 1 out, hits6/5/4, protected fouls0.
verifiedEvidence.disclosure: Two unfinished first-pitch probes and zero-pitch changes are excluded from complete-run counts.

unitFixturesOnly: Protection activation, exclusions, expiry, saved-strikeout distinction and +8 reward are tested with controlled engine states, not represented as natural UI play.
limits: No win-rate, relative deck-strength, counterfactual benefit, human-fun or commercial-quality conclusion.
Latest responsive measurements and screenshots were captured by root, following reviewer advice; do not describe them as reviewer-operated browser checks.
